scope: One real overnight INTERCITY_BUS service: Incheon Airport T2 → Cheongju, 23:00 → next day 01:25. iOS Simulator timetable selection, explicit terminal confirmation, connection, save and process relaunch.

environment.providerReason: Prior ODsay 429; dedicated TMAP session only, operating defaults and env files unchanged.
environment.authentication: Separate normal synthetic UI/API accounts; no database injection.
environment.clock: Actual current time on device/server. No clock override or elapsed-service bypass.

api.initialRoute: Captured real TMAP response for direct route geometry/type; its service=0 is not used as operating proof. Actual future service comes from live TAGO.
api.connections: Two real TMAP pedestrian calls, approach and egress to a real terminal parking POI
api.flow: Live TAGO → current FE connection builder → normal POST → GET → FE restore → normal personal travel-plan update → shifted departure rejected 400 → original preserved

native.flow: Real TMAP direct-route search → live TAGO today service → explicit same-terminal confirmation → real connection search → save with alarms disabled → process termination/relaunch → restored 23:00, 01:25 and unconfirmed booking label
native.nativeDestination: Cheongju bus terminal; egress walk may be omitted within 30m of the terminal
native.scheduleRetained: One evidence schedule on its isolated UI account; API cases deleted only their own schedules.

native01.reason: Test recent-place seed used name instead of API label/placeName; fixed seed and verified returned labels.

native02.reason: Test selected a multi-long-distance transfer route. Existing one-ride validation rejected it. Test now explicitly chooses the matching direct route with a daytime arrival deadline.
native02.postFailureDiagnostics: Optional simctl diagnostics collection stopped after test execution completed; test was not interrupted.

native03.reason: Test query used count on XCUIElement; corrected to XCUIElementQuery.

native04.reason: Direct bus existed, but test compared abbreviated display name 인천T2 against raw provider name 인천공항T2. Corrected the display assertion. Optional post-failure diagnostics stopped after test completion.

native05.reason: Dedicated simulator stopped responding to launch and screenshot. Canceled runner startup, restarted only owned simulator, preserved data, then reran.

api01.reason: Expected error text was status 400 while helper returned : 400. Server correctly rejected the shifted departure; assertion corrected.

typecheckInitial.reason: Optional Place.name was passed to URLSearchParams. Added normal fallback labels; final typecheck passed.

priorAttempts.counting: Final checks are counted once. Prior failures, repeat API passes and earlier stages are not added to final counts.

limitations: Representative route and service only; nationwide coverage not established
No actual purchase, ticket, remaining seats, boarding gate or internal airport/terminal path verified
Connections and buffers remain estimates; public timetable is unconfirmed booking
Notifications disabled; live departure guidance and device delivery not tested
Bus booking app connection and ticket import remain pending
Physical iPhone and Android deferred by user
No backend source changes or backend regression rerun; general ETA guard deployment remains a separate check
